question: We can add a table in an MS Word document from which of the following tabs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Insert Tab**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• You can add a table in an MS Word document by navigating to the **Insert Tab**.
 
• Within the Insert Tab, you can find the option to create a table, allowing you to specify the number of rows and columns.
 
• The Insert Tab provides various other functionalities such as inserting pictures, shapes, charts, and other elements into your document.
 
• Using the Insert Tab for adding tables helps in organizing data effectively in a structured format.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Design Tab** is primarily used for formatting and designing the layout of the document, including themes, colors, and fonts.
 
• The **View Tab** allows you to change the view modes of your document, such as Print Layout, Web Layout, and Reading Mode.
 
• The **Home Tab** contains basic formatting options like font style, size, paragraph alignment, and bullet points.
 
• MS Word offers a range of features to enhance the usability and presentation of documents, making it a versatile tool for both personal and professional use.
